messages:
mina: quick heads-up while onboarding a new int8 build (voyager-lite): found deterministic detok oddity. when a Chinese quoted phrase immediately follows an Arabic/RTL fragment the CJK corner quotes are swapped in the decode. float32 and spm roundtrip are fine.

lee: can you paste the minimal repro + tokenizer + whether this is local/staging?

mina: tokenizer=voyager-sp. repro (minimal): Translate to zh: "He said \"Good morning\" in Arabic: صباح". int8 decode -> corner quotes reversed around the CJK phrase. float32 decode OK.

yusuf: if token ids are identical then it's a detok mapping/kernel issue. can you run tok.encode/decode and paste ids?

mina: ids around quotes match float32; decode differs only on int8 runtime. switching detok_table to table_v2 on int8 fixes the case, so table_v3 + fused-detok path seems suspect.

sasha: please add the smallest repro to token-diff-suite and create a regression ticket. plan: hotfix to force table_v2 for RTL inputs on int8 -> canary -> bisect+revert offending change -> unit tests -> staged rollout.

infra-bot: ci artifact: /runs/1755551234/voyager-lite-int8-smoke (160 mixed-locale samples). chrF dropped 0.776 -> 0.713; failures concentrated where CJK follows RTL.

yusuf: starting bisect on detok_fuse and detok_table commits. smallest failing sample is the Arabic + quoted CJK phrase above; using it for automated bisect. will open PR to revert the reorder and add unit tests once isolated.

mina: validating hotfix canary now. will rerun the repro and smoke once canary is up and post results here.
